spoken_lines.speaker: V
spoken_lines.text: Pair Seven moved up twelve hours. Timestamp starts two minutes after the Kabuki relay went dark.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: Then Cinder did not interrupt the route. She made it show its hand.

spoken_lines.speaker: V
spoken_lines.text: Freight packaging full of neural suppressants.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: They damp memory rejection. Enough keeps the foreign fragments quiet. Too much makes the courier unable to recognize their own.

spoken_lines.speaker: V
spoken_lines.text: Restraints, bite guard, biomonitor. No sedative line.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: They keep the couriers conscious. A sleeping brain cannot confirm the graft still feels real.

spoken_lines.speaker: V
spoken_lines.text: Beacon is seated. Controller thinks it belongs there.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: Good. I only need one valid route heartbeat.

spoken_lines.speaker: V
spoken_lines.text: Found Zero-Seven-B. Box truck, refrigerated registry, heading for an interchange in Northside.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: And Zero-Seven-A just resolved. I have Mara's clinic.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: The beacon authenticated without an alarm. Black Lantern still believes Pair Seven is on schedule.

spoken_lines.speaker: Patch
spoken_lines.text: Clean enough to make me jealous. I try that and a door asks for three references.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: Yard raised an intrusion flag. The beacon is still transmitting, but the clinic will know somebody touched the route.

spoken_lines.speaker: Patch
spoken_lines.text: Freight crew is shouting into every channel they own. Clinic will be awake. Probably armed. Definitely rude.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: Sending Mara's location now. The jammer around her implant is stronger than the clinic walls. Disable it before you search for her.
